items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you know Holly Hofmann? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was Ted Curson. I don’t mind saying who it is, the trumpet player, Ted Curson. I’m sure it was an event that he wouldn’t remember. To him it was probably just a silly off comment, like teasing a young woman.
